sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The sidebar's ◀/▶ handle is there as soon as a supported MusicBrainz page opens, before any button is pressed, with the sidebar open and the page laid out exactly as MusicBrainz draws it. Once a button has rendered the table, "Start with sidebar collapsed" closes it as before. New settings: "Sidebar handle before a button is pressed" (on) and "Start with sidebar collapsed before a button is pressed" (off).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Two new switches for the link previews (⚙️ → 🔎 LINK PREVIEWS ON MUSICBRAINZ, both on by default): "Link previews (hover card and Space window)" turns every hover card and Space window off at once, and the script then adds nothing for them to the page; "Link previews also before a button is pressed", off, keeps a supported page as MusicBrainz draws it until a button has rendered the table.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The Relationships column's ⚠️ WARNING "Several Discogs links in Relationships" is now "Several links to one site in Relationships": two or more different links to ANY one site (two Discogs pages, two amazon.de products, two pages of one Bandcamp artist, …) flag the cell. A site is the host without "www.", so amazon.de and amazon.com, or music.apple.com and itunes.apple.com, stay one link each and never flag. The cell's tooltip and the icon's popup name every site involved with its links. Its two switches keep their saved values; the new setting "Sites allowed more than one link in Relationships" lists hosts that never count.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Relationships column: hovering a cell's ⚠️ (several Discogs links) no longer replaces it with the reload ⟳ at the cell's right edge. The ⚠️ stays at the right edge, the ⟳ appears right after the icons as on any other cell, and the cell's tooltip keeps the warning above the reload hint instead of losing it.

Relationships column: the popup of an icon in such a cell now starts with the warning itself, with the links involved and the icon you point at marked, under a link preview card as well as without one. Only the ⚠️ WARNING menu showed it before.
